newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says repulses Eritrean, rebel attack in east.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says repulses Eritrean, rebel attack in east.

text.p: A Sudan army spokesman was quoted on Wednesday as saying that Khartoum's forces have repulsed an Eritrean and rebel attack in northeast Sudan.

The official news agency SUNA quoted Army spokesman Lt-General Mohamad al-Sanousi Ahmad as saying Sudan forces repulsed the Eritrean-rebel attack at dawn on Tuesday at Gadamai, about 250 km (155 miles) north of Kassala, the main town in the eastern area.
"The aggressors were forced to flee leaving behind their killed, wounded and arms," he said, but gave no figures.

Sudan has accused Eritrea, Ethiopia and Uganda of fighting alongside the rebels, whose attacks gained momentum this year and who want to spark a popular uprising to topple President Omar Hassan al-Bashir. The three states deny involvement.
